banner.title: echo
banner.tagline: Echoes back each request as Envoy forwards it, so you can see the headers and path a backend receives, behind Authentik.

art.about: a request passing an auth gate and coming back as an echo
art.title: How echo reflects a request

explainer.title: A request in, the request back out

steps.title: Gate
steps.text: The SecurityPolicy echo-auth asks the Authentik embedded outpost about every request before Envoy forwards it.
steps.scene: a padlock at a gateway arch

steps.title: Route
steps.text: HTTPRoute echo attaches only to the HTTPS listener of envoy-external, on the echo host.
steps.scene: a single route leading to one door

steps.title: Echo
steps.text: The container returns the method, path, headers and body to the caller, and logs each request except the health probe.
steps.scene: a mirror reflecting a request card
